final_looks.text: Intraday in a FALLING market (NIFTY below a falling 50-day average): when the stock opens >= 2% away from yesterday's close (call auction), trade the stock against the move at 09:15 (MIS); stop 1.00% / target 2.00% from entry (1:2), else exit at 15:15.

Scalping in a SIDEWAYS market (neither rising nor falling): when the stock opens >= 1% away from yesterday's close (call auction), trade the stock against the move at 09:15 (MIS); exit 10 minutes after entry.
